RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday, the December 16, 2005/Agrahayana 25, 1927 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Agriculture; Chemicals and Fertilizers; Consumer Affairs,
Food and Public Distribution; Environment and Forests;
Food Processing Industries; Health and Family
Welfare; Railways; Steel)
Total number of questions — 20
Negative growth in crucial crops
*341. SHRIMATI AMBIKA SONI:
SHRI ANAND SHARMA:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the reports from across the
country suggest a negative growth in
output of crucial crops such as paddy,
coarse grains, pulses and oilseeds;
(b) whether Government have received
full report of erratic rainfall in the country
and its effect on these coarse grains;
(c) whether the rains in September have
also improved the position;
(d) if so, whether any final estimate of
negative growth in Kharif crop has been
made; and
(e) if so, the action plan being
considered by Government?
Damage caused by wild elephants in
Assam
*342. SHRI SILVIUS CONDPAN: Will
the Minister of ENVIRONMENT AND
FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) the details of action taken to prevent
the regular movement of wild elephants
within the habitation of tea gardens and
villages under Amaribari Forest Range of
DFO Tezpur in Sonitpur district, Assam
for it causes damage to paddy, land,
houses, property as well as people;
(b) whether any compensation has been
paid to the affected families and the
agencies entrusted with the task;
(c) the total forest cover maintained
during the last five years as well as the
details of forest marked as elephant
conservation in Assam; and
(d) the steps taken to push back these
wild elephants to the conservation area?
Damage to onion crop in
Maharashtra
*343. SHRI SANJAY RAUT:
SHRI TARIQ ANWAR:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether heavy rains and floods in
Maharashtra have caused extensive
damage to onion crop in Maharashtra, if
so, the extent of loss and damage to the
crop;

106
(b) what percentage of demand for
onion in the country is met by Maharashtra,
and how far the recent onion crisis in the
country was attributable to this damage;
and
(c) what Central aid, if any, was sought
and given to the Government of
Maharashtra to help the farmers out of the
crisis caused by such damage to onion crop?
Health-care for All
*344. SHRI C. PERUMAL: Will the
Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether any target for taking health
care to all parts of the country has been
fixed;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) whether Government are aware that
CII’s health committee and Escorts Heart
Institute have conducted a study and found
that Rs. 1 lakh crores will be required for
'Health-care for All' project?
Co-ordination Committee for
agricultural development
*345. SHRIMATI VANGA GEETHA:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have
constituted the Agriculture Co-ordination
Committee to focus on agricultural
development and policy;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government have set any
time-frame to implement the
recommendations of such Committee; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Price control on drugs
*346. SHRI V. NARAYANASAMY:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are planning
to ease control on pricing of drugs
manufactured in India; and
(b) whether Government studied the
position that would arise by relaxing the
control on drug prices after which the drugs
will become costlier for the consumers?
National Steel Policy
*347. SHRI JESUDASU SEELAM:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI
REDDY:
Will the Minister of STEEL be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government have decided
to form a Group of Ministers to finalize an
action plan and monitor implementation of
much awaited National Steel Policy;
(b) whether Government have
announced the Steel policy;
(c) if so, the details of the same; and
(d) whether this policy has been fully
approved by the Group of Ministers?
Increasing coverage of BPL families
under TPDS
*348. SHRI SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
SHRI HARISH RAWAT:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:

107
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(a) the total number of BPL families
identified/covered under the Targeted Public
Distribution System (TPDS); and
(b) the reasons for not covering the
entire BPL families identified under the
TPDS?
Medicines available without
prescriptions
*349. SHRI ANAND SHARMA: Will
the Minister of CHEMICALS AND
FERTILIZERS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that fast action
potent sedative drugs like Ketamine and
Rohypnol are available in the market
without prescriptions and there are reports
of their rampant misuse; and
(b) if so, the steps proposed to restrict
the sale of such drugs in the market?
Accidents due to failure of safety
norms and human errors
*350. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of RAILWAYS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that causes of
accidents of trains are failure of giving due
attention to rail safety and non-
implementation of safety norms;
(b) the details of train accidents in 2004
and 2005 due to failure of safety norms
and by human error;
(c) what penalty is imposed on those
employees who violate safety norms;
(d) how many persons have been
booked for non-implementation of safety
norms during 2004 and 2005; and
(e) the steps taken by Government to
ensure strict compliance of safety norms?
Stalls at platforms in Konkan
†*351. SHRI VASANT CHAVAN: Will
the Minister of RAILWAYS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Railways on
the demand of the residents of Konkan,
had assured them at the time of introducing
Konkan Railway in Maharashtra to provide
stalls at the railway platforms;
(b) if so, the number of unemployed
persons to whom stalls have been provided
at railway platforms so far and the details
thereof; and
(c) if not, whether Government would
consider to provide employment to such
unemployed persons as per their demand?
Strike by CGHS staff
†*352. SHRIMATI MAYA SINGH:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether about thirty thousand health
employees of various institutions of the
Central Government went on strike on
18 November, 2005, which had widely
affected the health services;
(b) if so, the reasons for their strike;
(c) whether employees have requested
Government to accept their demands before
going on strike; and
(d) if so, the steps taken by Government
to accept their demands?
Rotary Cancer Hospital at AIIMS
*353. SHRIMATI JAYA
BACHCHAN:
  SHRI PRAMOD MAHAJAN:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:

108
(a) whether it is a fact that the Dr. B. R.
Ambedkar Indian Rotary Cancer Hospital
at AIIMS has been delayed and is yet to
become fully operational and if so, the
reasons therefor;
(b) whether it is also a fact that the
equipment and external services had not
been planned alongwith the construction
of the building thus contributing to the
delay and if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) by when the cancer unit is likely to
become fully operational?
Design and manufacture of
agricultural equipments
*354. SHRI S. ANBALAGAN: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government have taken any
steps during the last two years to design
and manufacture agricultural equipments
which are suitable for Indian conditions and
for enabling the farmers to carry out farm
operations economically and efficiently;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
success achieved therefrom;
(c) whether the country is still lagging
behind many countries in farm
mechanisation; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and the steps
proposed to be taken by Government in
this regard?
Frequency of Bhubaneswar-
Yeswantpur-Bhubaneswar Express
*355. SHRI B. J. PANDA: Will the
Minister of RAILWAYS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Bhubaneswar
Citizens’ Forum has requested the railway
authorities to increase the frequency of the
Bhubaneswar-Yeswantpur-Bhubaneswar
Express from once to twice a week, due to
heavy rush of traffic; and
(b) if so, the status of the proposal and
the time-frame within which it would be
agreed to?
Restructuring of FACT
*356. SHRI K. CHANDRAN PILLAI:
Will the Minister of CHEMICALS AND
FERTILIZERS be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is any proposal
pending for restructuring of the FACT;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the total amount required for the
restructuring;
(d) whether Government have released
the required amount for the purpose; and
(e) if so, the details thereof and the
present status of the restructuring process?
Registered nursing institutions in the
country
*357. SHRI N. K.
PREMACHANDRAN: Will the Minister
of HEALTH AND FAMILY WELFARE
be pleased to state:
(a) the number of registered nursing
institutions in the country, both
Government and private, approved by the
Indian Nursing Council and the number of
those institutions in Kerala;
(b) whether the Council had prescribed
and maintained any guidelines for the
approval of these institutions and whether
any instances have been reported from any
State relating to the irregular approval of
those institutions which have got no basic
amenities; and
(c) whether any such instances have
been brought to the notie of Government
from Kerala and if so, the details thereof?

109
NEW DELHI; YOGENDRA NARAIN,
The 10th December, 2005 Secretary-General.
Agrahayana 19, 1927 (Saka)
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Decline in fish production
*358. SHRI PRAMOD MAHAJAN:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether there has been a great fall in
fish production especially wild stock from
sea and rivers;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) the corrective measures being
undertaken to stimulate the fish
production?
Disparity in prices of drugs and
medical equipments
*359. SHRI NANDI YELLAIAH: Will
the Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that catheter of
different companies have different prices
with huge variation;
(b) the details of medicines and medical
equipments serving the same purpose but
having abnormal deviations in prices;
(c) the detailed reasons for such
abnormal deviations in prices though they
serve the same purpose and all of them are
manufactured by standard companies; and
(d) the measures already taken and
proposed to be taken to put an end to such
deviations in prices and develop an effective
price controlling vigilant monitoring system
throughout India?
Amendment of the Forest
(Conservation) Act, 1980
†*360.  SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
  SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
Will the Minister of ENVIRONMENT
AND FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Chief
Ministers of States in the country have
demanded that more rights should be
provided to the tribals by amending the
Forest(Conservation)  Act, 1980;
(b) if so, the names of the States which
have made this demand and when such
demand was made; and
(e) the decision taken, so far, by
Government to effect amendments in the
above Act?

Agricultural contribution to GDP
2577. DR. ALLADI P. RAJKUMAR:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
contribution of agriculture to GDP ratio is
declining year after year; and
(b) if so, the reasons therefor and the
efforts made by Government to improve
the position?
Refusal of MSP on cotton by
Maharashtra to farmers
2578. SHRI SHARAD ANANTRAO
JOSHI: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state
whether it is a fact that Government of
Maharashtra is refusing to give the cotton
farmers of Maharashtra at the time of the
purchase more than 80 per cent of the
Minimum Support Price of cotton fixed
by the Central Government?
Study on impact of liberalized import
of agricultural products
2579. SHRI SK. KHABIR UDDIN
AHMED: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have
conducted any study to assess the impact
of liberalized import of agricultural products
on Indian agriculture; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Kisan Call Centres
2580. SHRI S. ANBALAGAN: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Kisan Call Centres (KCC)
have been set up in various States to assist
the farmers;
(b) if so, the number of such KCCs
opened in various States, so far, and the
details of their functions;
(c) whether more KCCs will be opened
in the country;
(d) if so, the details thereof, State-wise;

591
(e) whether information technology is
used by these centres to assist farmers;
and
(f) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
Scheme for cultivation of medicinal
plants
†2581. SHRI BALAVANT ALIAS
BAL APTE:
SHRI KRIPAL PARMAR:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are formulating
any scheme for promoting cultivation of
medicinal plants;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) if not, whether Government feel the
necessity of conducting a study in this
regard; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Operation of slaughter houses
†2582. SHRI RUDRA NARAYAN
PANY:
DR. SWAMI SAKSHI JI
MAHARAJ:
DR. CHHATTRAPAL SINGH
LODHA:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE
be pleased to state:
(a) the total number of livestock
district-wise/State-wise/Union Territory-
wise and species-wise;
(b) the names and addresses of licensed/
illegal slaughter houses operating in various
districts/States/Union Territories in the
country;
(c) the number of livestock being killed
everyday in slaughter houses operating
legally or illegally and the norms and rules
fixed for killing; and
(d) the details of the quantum and the
form in which meat is being sold in the
country and exported to foreign countries
from each slaughter house, year-wise?
Achieving rice production target
†2583. SHRI P.K. MAHESHWARI:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are seriously
contemplating over the reasons for not
achieving the targeted rice production;
(b) if so, the steps being taken by
Government in this regard so that the
production target can be achieved in the
forthcoming years; and
(c) whether any special proposal or
special advice in this regard has been given
by Government to the major rice producing
States in the country and if so, the details
thereof?
Schemes for development of
agriculture sector
2584. SHRI N.R. GOVINDARAJAR:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of the Centrally
sponsored schemes being implemented
togetherwith such fresh schemes proposed
for agricultural development in the country,
particularly in Tamil Nadu during the last
three years;
(b) the details of the achievements made
in this regard during the above said period,
State-wise; and
(c) the amount of funds utilised under
those schemes, so far?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

592
Agricultural contribution to GDP
2585. DR. GYAN PRAKASH
PILANIA: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) the population in percentage and
number which is dependent on agriculture
and agriculture sector;
(b) its contribution to the GDP during
the last ten years;
(c) how it matches with the targets fixed
therefor, year-wise;
(d) how it compares with GDP
contribution by other sectors, namely,
service, industrial, I.T., manufacturing, etc.;
(e) the work force employed in
agriculture sector and the percentage thereof
to the total employment potential in the
country;
(f) the percentage of annual growth in
agriculture sector, during the last ten years;
(g) how it matches with the targets fixed
therefor, year-wise;
(h) the percentage of GDP invested in
agriculture sector as capital input, during
the last ten years, year-wise; and
(i) the corrective steps taken to re-
energize the agriculture sector?
Decrease in growth rate of agriculture
sector
†2586. SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA:
SHRIMATI KUM KUM RAI:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the growth
rate of agricultural sector is on the decrease
during the last decade;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether Government are formulating
any scheme to solve problems relating to
the agriculture sector in view of promoting
development of the same;
(d) whether Government are
formulating any scheme to increase
agricultural loans and to ensure easy
availability of loans to farmers for farming;
and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Use of plastic in agricultural activities
2587. SHRI SHAHID SIDDIQUI: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have recommended the use of plastic in
agricultural activities, if so, the justification
for this recommendation; and
(b) whether any study has been done
on the alternatives to plastic, if so, the
details thereof showing the comparative
cost-benefit ratio?
Gram Panchayat as unit under crop
insurance scheme
†2588. SHRI SURENDRA LATH: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the farmers of the country
have requested Government to consider
Gram Panchayat as unit instead of Block
under crop insurance scheme so that farmers
could get insurance on damage of crops in
entire Panchayat, due to natural calamity;
(b) if so, the steps taken by Government
in this regard and the outcome thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

National Horticulture Mission
2589. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA : Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) the aims and objectives of the
National Horticulture Mission;
(b) the details of areas that have been
identified in Andhra Pradesh which are
regionally different from others for cluster
approach and for the development of
horticulture crops in the State;
(c) the difference between Technology
Mission for integrated development to
Horticulture and NHM;
(d) the total allocation made for NHM
in the Tenth Plan for Andhra Pradesh; and
(e) the targets set for National
Horticulture Mission?
Weight of milk pouches at mother
dairy
†2590. SHRI AJAY SINGH
CHAUTALA: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the fact that milk pouches at mother dairy
outlets weigh less;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) the corrective steps being taken by
Government in this regard?
Implementation of animal
husbandry schemes
†2591. PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA: W ill the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the schemes
for the animal husbandry are not being
implemented properly;
(b) if so, the reaction of Government
thereto; and
(c) the efforts made by Government in
this regard so that livestock can be used
properly?
Foodgrain production and shortage
†2592. SHRIMATI   PREMA
CARIAPPA:
SHRI  MOTILAL  VORA:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE
be pleased to state:
(a) the ratio of growth rate of foodgrain
production and population in the country;
(b) the extent of shortfall registered in
the foodgrain stocks in the country during
the last two years;
(c) whether Government have taken any
concrete steps to avoid import of foodgrains
from foreign countries; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Assistance to Maharashtra for
kharif crop loss
2593. SHRI DATTA MEGHE: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that about 35 to
40 thousand farmers in Vidarbha region of
Maharashtra have been badly affected by
the loss to their standing kharif crops on
more than 30 thousand hectares, due to
torrential rains this year;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the assistance provided by the Union
Government to farmers whose kharif crop
has been damaged?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

Assistance to J&K for agricultural
production
2594. SHRI T.S. BAJWA: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
grant special status to J&K to increase its
agricultural production;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the details of the steps taken by
Government for promoting agriculture to
improve the condition of farmers in the
State; and
(d) the details of the amount allocated
for the purpose during the last three years?
Employment melas by CIFNET
2595. SHRI V. HANUMANTHA
RAO: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have asked the Central Institute of Fisheries
Nautical and Engineering Training
(CIFNET) to hold employment or rozgar
melas to find trained and certified crew for
imported deep-sea fishing vessels and tuna
boats;
(b) the number of such employment
melas held by CIFNET of Cochin in the
last six weeks;
(c) the number of people who came
forward and could be hired as fishing hands
and other jobs;
(d) whether it is a fact that CIFNET
has agreed to supply adequate crew to all
companies operating deep-sea tuna vessels;
and
(e) if so, the details of the assurance
given by CIFNET and Government to
imported tuna boat operators?
Farmers leaving agriculture
2596. SHRI SANJAY RAUT:
SHRI R.K. ANAND:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that more than 40
per cent farmers would like to quit
agriculture business due to unsafe and low
margin to agro-produce, water dependent
production as well as unavailability of
agriculture loan on lower percentage of
interest rate in the country;
(b) if so, Government's views and
reaction thereto; and
(c) the details of measures taken or
proposed to be taken for improving the
current unfavourable atmosphere in the
agriculture by keeping in view the poor
farmers of the country?
Shortfall in agricultural production

Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether despite upbeat projections,
preliminary estimates shows that
agriculture sector is already falling short of

2006;
(b) if so, whether foodgrain target for
that period is 215 million tonnes and kharif
production 110 million tonnes but the first
advance estimates puts it at 105.25 million
tonnes;
(c) whether this will be marginally up
from the last year but will be short of the
target;
(d) if so, the details of the target set;
and

595
(e) the steps taken to meet the foodgrain
shortfall?
Subsidy to MSCCGMFL
2598. SHRI R.S. GAVAI: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
of Maharashtra has submitted a proposal
for subsidy to Maharashtra State Co-
operative Cotton Growers Marketing
Federation Limited for maintaining MSP
of cotton during the season 2004-05 and
2005-06;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) by when the subsidy will be given
to Government of Maharashtra for the
above purpose?
Criteria for sanctioning KVKs
2599. SHRI SK. KHABIR UDDIN
AHMED: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) the criteria for sanctioning Krishi
Vigyan Kendras; and
(b) the names of the districts where
KVKs are proposed to be set up in West
Bengal?
Substandard seeds manure and
pesticides
2600. SHRI T.T.V. DHINAKARAN:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the fact that substandard seeds, manure and
pesticides are responsible for low
agricultural production;
(b) if so, whether Government have
made any study to assess this issue;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) the details of existing mechanisms
to regulate quality of seeds, manure and
pesticides?
Research projects by ICAR for
Andhra Pradesh
2601. SHRI C.
RAMACHANDRAIAH: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) the details of research projects in
agriculture funded by the Indian Council of
Agricultural Research (ICAR) during the
last one and a half year;
(b) the details of projects earmarked for
Andhra Pradesh;
(c) the amount released during that
period;
(d) the number of projects to be taken
up by the ICAR in the State during
2005-2006; and
(e) the number of ad-hoc projects to be
funded by Government of Andhra Pradesh
during 2005-2006?
Problem in agriculture sector
†2602. SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have
conducted a survey with regard to the
problems being faced in the development
of agriculture sector;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

596
(b) if so, the main problems identified
so far;
(c) the problems out of the above which
are due to paucity of funds;
(d) the problems which are due to lack
of knowledge; and
(e) the decline noticed in agriculture
sector due to the same?
Cotton production
2603. SHRI PYARELAL
KHANDELWAL: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that over 230
lakh bales of cotton was produced in the
cotton season 2004-05;
(b) whether the cotton crop is expected
to be over 270 lakh bales in the cotton
season 2005-06 and whether this will affect
the prices;
(c) whether Government are
contemplating to export surplus cotton;
(d) whether Government are aware that
China will be short of cotton by almost 2.5
to 3 million metric  tonnes in the cotton
season 2005-06; and
(e) the details of the cotton export plan?
